definitions.explanation: Milk that has been thickened by evaporating water and adding sugar. A sweet, thick white liquid commonly used as a topping for desserts.

examples.japanese: いちごに{練乳|れんにゅう}をかけた。
examples.english: I poured condensed milk on strawberries.

examples.japanese: かき{氷|ごおり}に{練乳|れんにゅう}をたっぷりかけるのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like pouring lots of condensed milk on shaved ice.

examples.japanese: このお{菓子|かし}のレシピには{練乳|れんにゅう}が{大|おお}さじ{二杯|にはい}{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: This dessert recipe requires two tablespoons of condensed milk.

notes:
A thick, sweet dairy product made by removing water from milk and adding sugar. In Japan, most commonly associated with strawberries and shaved ice (かき{氷|ごおり}).

ALTERNATE FORMS:
- Also written as コンデンスミルク (from English 'condensed milk')
- Informally called {練乳|れんにゅう} or れんみるく in some regions

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {練乳|れんにゅう}をかける: to pour condensed milk on
- いちご{練乳|れんにゅう}: strawberries with condensed milk
- {練乳|れんにゅう}{入|い}り: containing condensed milk
- {加糖|かとう}{練乳|れんにゅう}: sweetened condensed milk (official term)

RELATED WORDS:
- {無糖|むとう}{練乳|れんにゅう}: evaporated milk (unsweetened)
- {粉|こな}ミルク: powdered milk / baby formula
- {生|なま}クリーム: fresh cream
